svg.title: SpaceLab question-to-answer process flow
svg.desc: Validate the question and boolean web-search setting. Read merged data. Filter all records and use BM25, numeric ranking or a complete listing. Off keeps dataset-only processing; on searches Ollama for separate web references. Missing dataset evidence can be supplemented by valid external web excerpts. Preserve computed dataset results, validate model citations, show explicit search errors or model fallback, and display references separately. Edited values are read for new requests and all downloads.
svg.text: 01 · BROWSER
Submit question and current settings
POST /api/ask · web_search defaults to false
Web on selects AI; choosing Offline turns Web off.
02 · INPUT CHECK
Validate question, size, settings and boolean
Invalid request → HTTP 400 / 413; revise the input.
03A · DATASET PATH · ALWAYS
Read bundled records + saved edits
Apply exact place / state / topic filters to the full corpus.
Rank / list query → numeric sort or all matching rows.
Other query → BM25 over every matching record.
No fixed source-count limit.
03B · WEB PATH · ONLY WHEN ENABLED
Search the question using Ollama Cloud
Return up to 5 external excerpts with source URLs.
Success → web_sources, source IDs and retrieval times.
Empty / error → dataset-only result + search notice.
Off → skip this path entirely.
04A · DATASET OUTCOME
Choose computed results, excerpts or AI
Rank / list → deterministic computed results.
Matching records + AI mode → dataset-only model answer.
Offline → source excerpts; model failure → fallback.
Missing evidence / live request → insufficient evidence.
04B · WITH USABLE WEB REFERENCES
Provide a separate external evidence set
AI may answer even when dataset evidence is insufficient.
Synthetic values remain distinct from external context.
Rank / list: retain results and request an external addendum.
Offline API requests can show web excerpts without AI.
05 · OPTIONAL MODEL CALL
Question + evidence → configured Ollama model
Untrusted input remains data; model credentials stay on server.
Use dataset-only or dataset + web system instructions.
Search / model calls use timeouts; report fallback honestly.
06 · COMPOSE & CHECK
Preserve computed results; validate model citations
Source IDs must belong to the supplied evidence.
Web-assisted generated answers must cite a supplied WEB ID.
Missing / invalid citations or model errors → labelled excerpts.
Direct computed / excerpt / insufficient result
07 · RETURN RESPONSE
Dataset sources + separate web sources and status
answer · actual mode · status · notice · web_search
Web search failures remain visible even with a dataset answer.
Dataset-only requests never call the search provider.
08 · DISPLAY & VERIFY
Answer → Clarification → References → optional JSON download
Keep inline IDs out of the displayed prose. Separate synthetic dataset cards from clickable external web references.
Citation checks establish source identity; users still verify dates, claims, relevance and limitations.
DATA FRESHNESS
Saved edits are read by the next question, ranking, map refresh and dataset download.
